metrics.name: fully_loaded_mobile
metrics.plain: how long the page takes to be usable on a slow phone
metrics.formula: median load_ms of 3 throttled runs (slow 4G, 4x CPU, Pixel 5 profile)
metrics.window: latest run per page and variant
metrics.unavailable_when: no run recorded for that page in 7 days
metrics.benchmark: under 5 s on slow 4G (Google's own mobile guidance)

metrics.name: lcp_ms
metrics.plain: when the biggest visible thing on the page shows up
metrics.formula: median LCP from the PerformanceObserver, largest-contentful-paint entry
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days, or LCP entry never fired

metrics.name: fcp_ms
metrics.plain: when the first bit of the page appears
metrics.formula: median first-contentful-paint entry across 3 runs
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days

metrics.name: cls
metrics.plain: how much the page jumps while loading
metrics.formula: sum of layout-shift entry values with no recent input, median of 3 runs
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days

metrics.name: tbt_est_ms
metrics.plain: how long the page ignores taps and clicks while it loads
metrics.formula: sum of (long task duration minus 50 ms) for long tasks over 50 ms, median of 3 runs
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days

metrics.name: wire_bytes
metrics.plain: total data the page sends on one visit
metrics.formula: sum of transferSize across every resource, median of 3 runs
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days

metrics.name: first_party_vs_third_party_bytes
metrics.plain: how much weight is the brand's own code versus outside scripts
metrics.formula: split wire_bytes by request host: brand domain and CDN of record versus everything else
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; watched as a trend

metrics.name: requests_served
metrics.plain: how many separate files the page has to fetch
metrics.formula: count of resource timing entries
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days

metrics.name: console_errors_count
metrics.plain: how many script errors happen while the page loads
metrics.formula: count of console error and page error events during the run
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days

metrics.name: script_count_by_route
metrics.plain: how many scripts load from theme code, apps, tag manager and hardcoded tags
metrics.formula: count distinct script src grouped by known route (theme bundle, app embed, GTM container, inline)
metrics.source: speed_lab.measure request log plus app inventory
metrics.unavailable_when: no run in 7 days
metrics.benchmark: no fixed number; watched against the brand's own baseline

metrics.name: page_weight_budget_status
metrics.plain: pass or fail against the weight and script-count ceiling the brand agreed to
metrics.formula: compare wire_bytes and requests_served on the latest run against the stored budget for that page type
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days with no check
metrics.unavailable_when: no budget has been set for that page type yet
metrics.benchmark: brand's own agreed budget, not an industry number

metrics.name: cost_of_slowness_inr_per_month
metrics.plain: how much money the current load time is estimated to cost every month
metrics.formula: (current LCP minus target LCP in seconds) x brand's own measured conversion-loss-per-second x monthly sessions on that page x average order value
metrics.source: speed run LCP joined with the brand's own sales and traffic data
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days or if the underlying speed run is stale
metrics.unavailable_when: no brand-specific conversion-per-second figure has been measured yet, or sales/traffic data is missing
metrics.benchmark: none; this is the brand's own number, shown as a range, not a point estimate

metrics.name: regression_delta_pct
metrics.plain: how much slower or faster the site got since the last shipped baseline
metrics.formula: (latest run load_ms minus last-shipped baseline load_ms) divided by baseline load_ms
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days with no check
metrics.unavailable_when: no baseline has been recorded yet

metrics.name: days_since_last_speed_run
metrics.plain: how old the numbers on this page are
metrics.formula: today minus the measured_at date of the latest run for that page
metrics.freshness_rule: this metric defines freshness for the others
metrics.unavailable_when: never; shows a large number if there has never been a run

insights.name: unused fonts
insights.rule: a font file is requested but 0 glyphs from it render on the page
insights.sentence: {n} font files nobody sees cost {kb} KB on every visit

insights.name: third-party scripts over budget
insights.rule: script_count_by_route for third-party routes exceeds the page's stored script budget
insights.sentence: {n} outside scripts add {ms} ms and {kb} KB, over your budget of {budget}

insights.name: speed regression since last ship
insights.rule: regression_delta_pct worse than 10 percent since the last recorded baseline
insights.sentence: the page got {pct}% slower since the last check on {date}, likely from {suspect_change}

insights.name: LCP element still un-lazied or animated
insights.rule: the element flagged as the LCP source has loading=lazy, an active CSS animation, or is not preloaded
computed_from: image and script attributes captured in the run
insights.sentence: the {element} that decides how fast the page feels is still {problem}
insights.severity: ranked by ms of LCP delay estimated from the fix

insights.name: layout shift culprit
insights.rule: a single element accounts for over half of total CLS on a template
computed_from: speed_lab.measure layout-shift entries with element reference
insights.sentence: {element} on the {template} page causes most of the jumping; it has no reserved space
insights.severity: ranked by share of total CLS

insights.name: render-blocking code still present
insights.rule: a CSS or JS resource has renderBlockingStatus blocking and is not marked async or deferred
insights.sentence: {n} files still block the page from showing anything until they arrive
insights.severity: ranked by their combined delay to first paint

insights.name: dead analytics tag still firing
insights.rule: a request matches a known sunset tracking endpoint (for example old Universal Analytics)
insights.sentence: a tag that stopped working on {sunset_date} still loads and costs {kb} KB

insights.name: app adds weight with no clear revenue link
insights.rule: an app's script bytes rank in the top 5 by weight and the app inventory (SITE-C13) shows no attributed revenue
insights.sentence: {app} adds {kb} KB on every page and nothing in your sales data ties back to it
insights.severity: ranked by KB with no revenue link

insights.name: font variation count too high
insights.rule: more than 2 weights or styles of the same font family are loaded
computed_from: document.fonts list captured in the run
insights.sentence: {n} versions of {family} load when the page only uses {used}

insights.name: cache headers missing on static assets
insights.rule: a static asset (image, font, script, css) returns a cache-control max-age under 1 week or no cache-control header
computed_from: response headers captured in the run
insights.sentence: {n} static files are re-downloaded on every visit because caching is not set
insights.severity: ranked by how often that asset repeats across pages

insights.name: no CDN detected on a key page
insights.rule: response headers show no CDN-identifying header (for example cf-ray, x-served-by) on a page expected to run through one
computed_from: response headers captured in the run
insights.sentence: {page} is not being served through the CDN; every visit hits the origin

insights.name: dynamic step untested for peak load
insights.rule: a page depends on search, personalization or a live stock check and has no load-test result on file within 60 days of the next known sale date
insights.sentence: {feature} has never been tested under sale-day traffic and the next big sale is in {days} days
insights.severity: ranked by proximity to the sale date

insights.name: main-thread block on a key interaction
insights.rule: a long task over 200 ms overlaps the time window of a tap test on add-to-cart, variant picker, filter or search
insights.sentence: tapping {interaction} freezes the page for about {ms} ms

insights.name: page-weight budget breached by latest deploy
insights.rule: page_weight_budget_status is fail on the most recent scheduled or pre-deploy check
insights.sentence: the last deploy pushed {page} to {kb} KB, over its {budget} KB budget

insights.name: new page-builder page is heavy before it ships
insights.rule: a page built with an app page-builder measures over the page-type budget on its own pre-launch run
computed_from: speed_lab.measure run on the draft page
insights.sentence: the new {page} page weighs {kb} KB before it even goes live, {pct}% over budget

visuals.name: fix chain
visuals.shows: load time after each fix, cumulative, in shipping order
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder sees which single fix moved the number and can stop trusting a vague overall score

visuals.name: before and after filmstrip
visuals.shows: screenshots at fixed time steps, baseline versus the fixed page
visuals.why_this_chart: shows what the shopper actually sees, not just a millisecond number

visuals.name: request waterfall by party
visuals.shows: every request, colored first-party versus third-party, ordered by start time
visuals.why_this_chart: makes it obvious which outside scripts are blocking the page's own code

visuals.name: page-weight budget trend
visuals.type: line chart with a budget line
visuals.shows: page weight and script count at every deploy or scheduled check against the stored budget
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder sees the moment a deploy or app install crossed the line, not just today's number

visuals.name: script inventory table
visuals.shows: every script, its route, weight, blocking status and whether revenue ties back to it
visuals.why_this_chart: turns a vague slowness complaint into a ranked list a developer can act on line by line

visuals.name: cost of slowness bar
visuals.shows: estimated monthly rupees lost at current LCP versus at target LCP, for the pages that carry the most traffic
visuals.why_this_chart: translates milliseconds into the number a founder actually decides on

visuals.name: sale-readiness checklist
visuals.type: step chart or checklist with pass/fail dots
visuals.shows: each dynamic feature, its last load-test result and days left to the next sale
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder sees exactly what is untested before a big sale, not a general confidence score

not_elsewhere.claim: measures a real before-and-after per fix on a mirrored copy of the live page, with a filmstrip
not_elsewhere.vs: Google PageSpeed Insights gives a lab score and generic advice on today's page only, with no isolated fix chain

not_elsewhere.claim: one Lighthouse-style score is replaced with a fix-by-fix chain a founder can stop trusting or not, item by item
not_elsewhere.vs: Shopify's Online Store Speed report is a single weighted score across the top 3 pages, not a per-fix breakdown

not_elsewhere.claim: cross-references every heavy script against the brand's own revenue attribution before calling it dead weight
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Thunder and similar Shopify speed-and-app audits, which rank apps by measured weight but do not check revenue

not_elsewhere.claim: turns a diagnosed fix straight into a brief with a pass threshold and a rollback plan, ready for a developer
not_elsewhere.vs: PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse CI report the problem; they do not write the fix instructions or the rollback plan

not_elsewhere.claim: prices slowness in the brand's own rupees per month, not a generic industry percentage
not_elsewhere.vs: no common speed tool ties LCP to the brand's own conversion rate and average order value

not_elsewhere.claim: regression checks point back to the exact fix chain and filmstrip already on file, so a regression names its own cause
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Lighthouse CI and SpeedCurve for budget-based regression alerts, without the same fix-level history to compare against

data_needs.refresh: weekly and on demand, plus before any deploy

data_needs.connector_or_script: SITE-C13 app audit (manual entry until a platform API is connected)
founder-set, stored by the regression monitor
manual entry from the brand's marketing calendar
Metabase pull plus a one-time speed-versus-conversion study per brand

founder_view_note: Before any run, every metric shows unavailable and the room says 'no speed run on file yet, ask the agent to capture a baseline'. The moment the first baseline lands, the room shows the baseline load time, the LCP element, and the top 3 insights ranked by KB or ms saved, even before any fix has shipped. The fix chain and filmstrip only appear once a fix has actually been measured, not proposed.

metrics.name: message_match_score
metrics.plain: how much of the ad's promise still shows on the page and at checkout
metrics.formula: matched elements (price, persona, guarantee, CTA wording) divided by total tracked elements from the ad, for the ad's own landing path
metrics.source: SITE-C36 audit, ad copy plus page and checkout scrape
metrics.window: current live pages, refreshed weekly or on any ad or page change
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days or the next time either the ad or the page changes
metrics.unavailable_when: the ad's landing page has not been scraped yet
metrics.benchmark: 100 percent; any gap is a named mismatch, not a score to average

metrics.name: hero_headline_specificity
metrics.plain: how concrete the hero headline is about the outcome
metrics.formula: rule-based check: contains a number, a timeframe or a named result versus a vague claim, scored 0 to 3
metrics.freshness_rule: stale when the hero copy changes
metrics.unavailable_when: no hero has been scored for that page yet
metrics.benchmark: score of 3; any page under 2 is flagged

metrics.name: pdp_first_screen_completeness
metrics.plain: how many of the 5 required buy-box elements show without scrolling on the brand's own phone
metrics.formula: count of (price, proof, CTA, variant picker, delivery info) visible above the fold on the brand's stated device, divided by 5
metrics.source: SITE-C38 audit, screenshot on the brand's real device viewport
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any theme or PDP change
metrics.unavailable_when: no device screenshot on file for that template

metrics.name: mobile_form_field_count
metrics.plain: how many fields a shopper fills before they can act, on mobile
metrics.formula: count of required input fields on the page's primary form (checkout, quiz start, or capture)
metrics.unavailable_when: page has no form

metrics.name: funnel_step_conversion
metrics.plain: what share of visitors move from one step to the next
metrics.formula: sessions reaching step N+1 divided by sessions reaching step N, for landing page to PDP to cart to checkout to purchase
metrics.source: analytics events (GA4 or the brand's pixel) joined to page_registry
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days with no new events
metrics.unavailable_when: analytics is not connected for that page
metrics.benchmark: the brand's own trailing 90-day median per step, not an industry number

metrics.name: test_expected_profit_ceiling
metrics.plain: the most this test could realistically be worth if it wins
metrics.formula: estimated lift range x affected traffic x average order value x margin, capped at a stated ceiling assumption
metrics.window: at the time the hypothesis is scored
metrics.freshness_rule: re-score if traffic or AOV moves more than 20 percent
metrics.unavailable_when: the hypothesis has fewer than 2 pieces of supporting evidence, which the rule requires before scoring
metrics.benchmark: none; used to rank the backlog, not compared to an external number

metrics.name: test_sample_size_required
metrics.plain: how many visitors this test needs before its result can be trusted
metrics.formula: computed from the chosen minimum detectable effect, baseline conversion rate and the test's statistical engine
metrics.freshness_rule: does not go stale; recomputed only if the MDE changes
metrics.unavailable_when: no minimum detectable effect has been set
metrics.benchmark: none; a design input, not a pass or fail number

metrics.name: days_to_significance_at_current_traffic
metrics.plain: how many more days this test needs at today's traffic
metrics.formula: (sample_size_required minus visitors so far) divided by average daily visitors to the test
metrics.source: live test traffic joined with test_sample_size_required
metrics.window: updated daily while a test is running
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 3 days with no new traffic data
metrics.unavailable_when: the test has not launched yet

metrics.name: sample_ratio_mismatch_flag
metrics.plain: whether traffic split evenly between the test arms the way it was set up to
metrics.formula: chi-square check of visitor counts per arm against the configured split
metrics.source: test platform export or SITE-C52 read
metrics.window: checked at every read of results
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 100 visitors per arm
metrics.benchmark: pass at p over 0.01; anything tighter is flagged before any result is trusted

metrics.name: device_split_of_test_traffic
metrics.plain: how the test's visitors split between mobile and desktop
metrics.formula: count of test sessions grouped by device type
metrics.window: while a test is running and at its final read
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 3 days with no new traffic
metrics.unavailable_when: test has not launched
metrics.benchmark: should roughly track the page's normal device split; a big gap is flagged

metrics.name: novelty_decay_pct
metrics.plain: how much of the lift was just people noticing something new
metrics.formula: lift in week 1 of the test minus lift in the weeks after, divided by week 1 lift
metrics.source: test platform export, weekly cohort read
metrics.window: computed once a test has run 3 or more weeks
metrics.unavailable_when: test has run fewer than 3 weeks or has under 100 conversions per arm
metrics.benchmark: under 20 percent decay is treated as a real, durable win

metrics.name: winner_ltv_return_check
metrics.plain: whether a scaled winner still looks good after returns and repeat orders are counted
metrics.formula: compare 30 and 60 day return rate and repeat-purchase rate of the winner cohort against the control cohort
metrics.source: SITE-C53, sales data joined to the test's order list
metrics.window: 30 and 60 days after a winner ships to 100 percent
metrics.freshness_rule: stale until 60 days have passed since full rollout
metrics.unavailable_when: fewer than 60 days have passed since rollout, or order-level attribution to the test is missing
metrics.benchmark: no worse than the control's return and repeat rate

metrics.name: landing_page_load_status
metrics.plain: whether the page this room is scoring is also fast enough to run traffic to
metrics.formula: pulled from the Site and speed room's fully_loaded_mobile and page_weight_budget_status for the same page
metrics.source: speed_lab.measure run table (shared with Site and speed)
metrics.window: latest speed run for that page
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 7 days, same rule as the speed room
metrics.unavailable_when: no speed run recorded for that page

metrics.name: urgency_claim_truth_status
metrics.plain: whether a displayed stock count or countdown is wired to a real number
metrics.formula: compare the displayed value against the live inventory or promo end-date feed at the same timestamp
metrics.source: page scrape joined to inventory feed
metrics.window: checked daily on live pages carrying an urgency element
metrics.unavailable_when: the page has no urgency element, or no inventory feed is connected
metrics.benchmark: match; any mismatch is flagged, not scored

metrics.name: proof_placement_coverage
metrics.plain: how many of the page's objections have proof placed next to them
metrics.formula: count of objections with a mapped proof element within the same page section, divided by total objections on the brand's objection list
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after any page or objection-list change
metrics.unavailable_when: no objection list exists yet for that SKU

insights.name: message-match break
insights.rule: message_match_score for an ad's landing path is under 100 percent
insights.sentence: the ad promises {promise} but the page says {page_text}, a mismatch on {element}
insights.severity: ranked by the ad's own spend

insights.name: hero missing a FUD reducer
insights.rule: no risk-reversal element (guarantee, free returns, security badge) sits within the hero's first viewport
insights.sentence: the hero on {page} has no reassurance next to the button

insights.name: PDP first screen incomplete
insights.rule: pdp_first_screen_completeness is under 5 of 5 on the brand's stated device
insights.sentence: {missing_element} does not show without scrolling on {device}
insights.severity: ranked by which element is missing (price and CTA rank highest)

insights.name: mobile form too long
insights.rule: mobile_form_field_count is over 4
insights.sentence: {page}'s form asks for {n} fields on a phone; the guideline is 4

insights.name: popup fires on load not on intent
insights.rule: a popup's trigger event fires on page load or a fixed timer instead of exit intent or scroll depth
insights.sentence: the popup on {page} interrupts before the shopper has shown any intent to leave

insights.name: fake urgency detected
insights.rule: urgency_claim_truth_status is mismatch
insights.sentence: {page} shows '{displayed_text}' but the real number is {actual_value}
insights.severity: always high, a trust and compliance issue

insights.name: sample ratio mismatch on a live test
insights.rule: sample_ratio_mismatch_flag fails
insights.sentence: test {test_name} is splitting traffic unevenly; its result cannot be trusted yet
insights.severity: always high; blocks trusting any result from that test

insights.name: win driven by novelty
insights.rule: novelty_decay_pct over 40 percent
insights.sentence: {test_name}'s lift fell {pct}% after week 1; the early win may not hold

insights.name: winner scaled without an LTV check
insights.rule: a test's status is shipped_to_100 and winner_ltv_return_check is unavailable more than 60 days after rollout
insights.sentence: {test_name} shipped {days} days ago with no return or repeat check run yet
insights.severity: ranked by days since rollout with no check

insights.name: high-value backlog item stalled
insights.rule: a backlog hypothesis in the top quartile of test_expected_profit_ceiling has been sitting untested for over 45 days
insights.sentence: {hypothesis} could be worth {ceiling} and has waited {days} days untested

insights.name: broken interactive control
insights.rule: a button, tab or accordion on a QA pass returns no visible change on click
insights.sentence: {control} on {page} does nothing when tapped
insights.severity: always high on a conversion surface

insights.name: bundle savings shown only as a percent
insights.rule: a bundle or offer block shows a percent-off with no rupee amount saved
insights.sentence: {offer} shows {pct}% off with no rupee saving stated

insights.name: proof stacked once instead of scattered
insights.rule: over 70 percent of a page's proof elements sit in a single section instead of distributed to their matched objection
insights.sentence: {page} has most of its proof in one place; {n} objections have none nearby
insights.severity: ranked by number of uncovered objections

insights.name: traffic routed to the wrong page type
insights.rule: a SKU's assigned awareness stage does not match the page type its ads currently point to (for example a cold, unaware audience sent straight to a bare PDP)
insights.sentence: {sku}'s ads target a cold audience but land on a bare PDP with no story
insights.severity: ranked by the SKU's ad spend

insights.name: test flicker on a slow connection
insights.rule: the QA pass on a throttled connection shows the original page for over 300 ms before the variant renders
insights.sentence: {test_name} flashes the original page for {ms} ms before the variant loads, on a slow connection

visuals.name: funnel by page
visuals.shows: sessions moving from landing page to PDP to cart to checkout to purchase, for the current page set
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder sees exactly which step leaks the most, not a single conversion rate

visuals.name: test backlog ranked list
visuals.shows: each hypothesis with its expected profit ceiling and evidence count
visuals.why_this_chart: ranks the backlog by money at stake instead of whoever argues loudest

visuals.name: message-match trace
visuals.shows: the ad's promise elements carried across to the page and checkout, with breaks marked in red
visuals.why_this_chart: makes an invisible drop-off (price or guarantee changing mid-funnel) visible in one glance

visuals.name: hero score card
visuals.shows: the hero's proof, headline, subhead, CTA and FUD scored against the fixed 6-part order
visuals.why_this_chart: turns a subjective 'does this feel strong' into named, fixable parts

visuals.name: test result chart
visuals.shows: conversion rate per arm with its confidence interval and sample ratio check
visuals.why_this_chart: shows whether a win is real before anyone celebrates it

visuals.name: winner LTV check
visuals.shows: return rate and repeat-purchase rate for the winner cohort versus control, day 0 to day 60
visuals.why_this_chart: catches a short-term win that quietly costs more in returns

visuals.name: PDP first-screen map
visuals.shows: the brand's real PDP screenshot on its own device with the 5 required elements marked present or missing
visuals.why_this_chart: grounds the completeness score in what the phone actually shows

not_elsewhere.claim: audits whether the ad's exact promise, price, guarantee and CTA wording survives unbroken from the ad to the page to checkout
not_elsewhere.vs: VWO and Convert.com report test statistics well but do not check message continuity from the ad itself

not_elsewhere.claim: ranks the test backlog by an expected-profit ceiling built from at least 2 pieces of evidence per hypothesis, before anything launches
not_elsewhere.vs: also in VWO's and Convert's own prioritization frameworks (PIE, ICE style scores), which score persuasion and ease but not a rupee ceiling tied to the brand's own traffic and AOV

not_elsewhere.claim: checks a scaled winner's return rate and repeat-purchase rate before calling it a lasting win
not_elsewhere.vs: test platforms report the conversion lift at the moment of the test; none of the common tools re-check returns and repeat orders 60 days later

not_elsewhere.claim: flags an urgency or scarcity claim as false the moment its displayed number stops matching real inventory or a real promo end date
not_elsewhere.vs: no common CRO or page-builder tool checks a countdown or stock count against the brand's own live feed

founder_view_note: Before any page has been audited, the room shows unavailable on every metric and a single line: 'no page has been scored yet, ask the agent to audit the top 3 ad landing pages first'. Once the first audit lands, the room leads with the message-match trace for the highest-spend ad, since a broken promise is the costliest and fastest thing to fix. The test backlog and results charts only populate once a test has been designed or launched; until then that panel says how many hypotheses are waiting to be scored.

metrics.name: launch_checklist_completion_pct
metrics.plain: how much of the launch checklist is done and verified
metrics.formula: items marked verified (not just checked) divided by total checklist items
metrics.window: current, until launch; then frozen as a record
metrics.unavailable_when: no checklist has been started
metrics.benchmark: 100 percent before the store password comes off

metrics.name: uptime_pct_30d
metrics.plain: how often the store was reachable over the last 30 days
metrics.formula: successful synthetic checks divided by total checks, rolling 30 days
metrics.freshness_rule: stale if no check has run in the last hour
metrics.unavailable_when: monitoring has not been set up yet

metrics.name: checkout_transaction_success_rate
metrics.plain: how often a real end-to-end test order completes
metrics.formula: successful synthetic checkout completions divided by attempts, across the store's active payment methods
metrics.freshness_rule: stale if no test has run in 24 hours
metrics.unavailable_when: no synthetic checkout test is configured
metrics.benchmark: 100 percent; any failure is treated as a live incident

metrics.name: payment_method_coverage
metrics.plain: how many of the planned payment methods actually work
metrics.formula: payment methods that pass a live go-live test divided by payment methods the brand intended to offer
metrics.freshness_rule: re-check after any gateway or region change
metrics.unavailable_when: go-live testing has not been run

metrics.name: app_count_no_revenue_link
metrics.plain: how many installed apps have no sales tied back to them
metrics.formula: count of active apps where revenue_attributed is null or zero over the last 90 days
metrics.source: SITE-C13 app inventory joined to sales attribution
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days with no re-check
metrics.unavailable_when: app inventory has not been built yet
metrics.benchmark: zero, or each one has a named non-revenue reason (legal, support)

metrics.name: script_count_key_pages
metrics.plain: how many third-party scripts load on the home, PDP, cart and checkout pages
metrics.formula: count of distinct third-party script hosts across those 4 templates
metrics.source: speed_lab.measure request log, shared with Site and speed
metrics.unavailable_when: no run recorded
metrics.benchmark: brand's own baseline; industry median is 21 to 30 per homepage, which is itself treated as a warning zone, not a target

metrics.name: residual_code_after_uninstall_count
metrics.plain: how many leftover snippets remain from apps that were removed
metrics.formula: count of theme code blocks or script tags referencing an app no longer in the active app list
metrics.unavailable_when: no code sweep has been run

metrics.name: accessibility_critical_issue_count
metrics.plain: how many serious accessibility problems the automated scan found
metrics.formula: count of WCAG 2.1 A and AA violations flagged critical or serious, across home, PDP, collection, cart and checkout templates
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 90 days or any template change
metrics.unavailable_when: no scan has been run

metrics.name: accessibility_manual_flag_count
metrics.plain: how many issues only a real keyboard or screen-reader test found
metrics.formula: count of findings logged during a manual pass on dynamic elements (variant picker, cart drawer, filters)
metrics.unavailable_when: no manual pass has been done

metrics.name: structured_data_coverage_pct
metrics.plain: how many eligible pages carry valid structured data
metrics.formula: pages with at least one valid schema block (Product, Offer, Review, BreadcrumbList or FAQPage) divided by pages eligible for that schema type
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days or a template change
metrics.unavailable_when: no crawl has been run

metrics.name: structured_data_error_count
metrics.plain: how many schema blocks exist but have errors
metrics.formula: count of schema blocks failing validation
metrics.unavailable_when: no crawl has been run

metrics.name: cod_pincode_coverage_pct
metrics.plain: how much of the brand's order footprint has a working COD serviceability check
metrics.formula: orders from pincodes with a serviceability rule configured divided by all orders in the window
metrics.source: SITE-C67 serviceability configuration joined to order data
metrics.unavailable_when: no serviceability rule set exists

metrics.name: rto_rate_pct
metrics.plain: what share of COD orders come back undelivered
metrics.formula: COD orders marked returned-to-origin divided by total COD orders, in the window
metrics.unavailable_when: logistics status is not fed back into order data
metrics.benchmark: the brand's own trailing baseline; India COD RTO commonly runs 15 to 30 percent industry-wide, shown only as context, not a target

metrics.name: cod_confirmation_rate
metrics.plain: how many COD orders get an OTP or WhatsApp confirmation before dispatch
metrics.formula: COD orders with a recorded confirmation event divided by total COD orders
metrics.unavailable_when: no confirmation flow is configured
metrics.benchmark: close to 100 percent of COD orders confirmed

metrics.name: broken_link_count
metrics.plain: how many dead links or redirect loops the last sweep found
metrics.formula: count of URLs returning a 404 or a redirect loop from an internal link or sitemap crawl
metrics.unavailable_when: no sweep has run

metrics.name: inventory_reconciliation_variance_pct
metrics.plain: how far the store's stock count drifts from the real count
metrics.formula: absolute difference between store-recorded stock and a physical or warehouse count, divided by warehouse count, averaged across checked SKUs
metrics.unavailable_when: no reconciliation has run

metrics.name: staging_drift_days
metrics.plain: how long since staging last matched production
metrics.formula: today minus the last successful staging sync date
metrics.freshness_rule: this metric is its own freshness signal
metrics.unavailable_when: no staging environment exists yet

metrics.name: consent_gate_pass_rate
metrics.plain: how often a tracking script actually waits for consent before firing
metrics.formula: test page loads where the tagged scripts fired only after a recorded consent event, divided by total test loads, per region
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days or any tag change
metrics.unavailable_when: no consent test has run

metrics.name: regression_test_pass_rate
metrics.plain: how often the automated flow tests pass after a change
metrics.formula: passed scripted flows (browse, cart, discount, checkout) divided by total flows run, for the latest change
metrics.freshness_rule: stale after 30 days with no run
metrics.unavailable_when: no regression suite has been set up

metrics.name: release_notes_backlog_count
metrics.plain: how many platform updates or deprecations have not been reviewed yet
metrics.formula: count of release-note items logged as unreviewed, across the platform, installed apps and API versions
metrics.unavailable_when: no tracking has been set up
metrics.benchmark: zero unreviewed items past their own deadline

insights.name: checklist item done but not verified
insights.rule: a launch checklist item is marked done but its own verification step (the action a real customer would take) has not been logged as passed
insights.sentence: {item} is marked done but was never actually tested the way a customer would use it

insights.name: app with no revenue link
insights.rule: app_count_no_revenue_link includes an app with a real monthly cost
insights.sentence: {app} costs {inr} a month and nothing in your sales data ties back to it

insights.name: leftover code after an uninstall
insights.rule: residual_code_after_uninstall_count is over 0
insights.sentence: {app} was removed but its code is still loading on {n} pages

insights.name: uptime or checkout incident
insights.rule: a synthetic check fails 2 checks in a row on any monitored endpoint
insights.sentence: {endpoint} failed {n} checks in a row starting at {time}, likely {suspected_cause}

insights.name: repeated accessibility violation across templates
insights.rule: the same WCAG rule fails on 3 or more of the 5 checked templates
insights.sentence: {rule} fails on {n} of your 5 key templates, most often {example}
insights.severity: ranked by number of templates affected

insights.name: missing alt text above threshold
insights.rule: over 10 percent of product images on a template have no alt text
insights.sentence: {pct}% of images on {template} have no alt text
insights.severity: ranked by pct of images missing alt text

insights.name: structured data errors block rich results
insights.rule: structured_data_error_count is over 0 on a PDP template
insights.sentence: {n} PDP pages have a broken {schema_type} block and cannot show rich results
insights.severity: ranked by number of PDPs affected

insights.name: RTO rate above the brand's own baseline
insights.rule: rto_rate_pct for the last 30 days is more than 20 percent above the brand's trailing 90-day average
insights.sentence: COD returns are running at {pct}%, up from your usual {baseline}%

insights.name: unconfirmed COD with high RTO
insights.rule: a pincode cluster has cod_confirmation_rate under 50 percent and rto_rate_pct over double the brand average
insights.sentence: {cluster} has almost no COD confirmation and returns {x} times more often than average
insights.severity: ranked by RTO multiple versus average

insights.name: staging out of sync
insights.rule: staging_drift_days is over 30
insights.sentence: staging has not matched production in {n} days; a change tested there is not safe to trust

insights.name: consent gate not actually blocking a script
insights.rule: consent_gate_pass_rate for a named script is under 100 percent
insights.sentence: {script} fires before consent is given on {pct}% of test loads

insights.name: broken link or redirect loop
insights.rule: broken_link_count is over 0 on a page linked from navigation or a sitemap
insights.sentence: {n} links are broken, including {example} linked from your main menu
insights.severity: ranked by whether the link sits in navigation or a sitemap

insights.name: inventory mismatch
insights.rule: inventory_reconciliation_variance_pct is over 2 percent for a SKU
insights.sentence: {sku} shows {store_count} in the store but {warehouse_count} in the warehouse

insights.name: unreviewed platform update past its deadline
insights.rule: a release-note item's own sunset or deprecation date has passed and it is still marked unreviewed
insights.sentence: {item} was deprecated on {date} and has not been reviewed yet
insights.severity: ranked by days past the sunset date

insights.name: new regression after a change
insights.rule: regression_test_pass_rate is under 100 percent on the run right after a theme or app change
insights.sentence: {flow} broke after the latest {change_type} change
insights.severity: always high; blocks shipping the change

visuals.name: launch checklist tree
visuals.shows: every launch item, whether it is done and whether it is verified
visuals.why_this_chart: separates 'someone clicked done' from 'a customer action actually proved it works'

visuals.name: uptime and incident timeline
visuals.shows: uptime and checkout success over the last 30 days with incidents marked and their duration
visuals.why_this_chart: a founder sees not just today's status but how often and how long things break

visuals.name: app and script inventory table
visuals.shows: every app with cost, weight and revenue link, red flagged when it has none
visuals.why_this_chart: turns 'we have too many apps' into a specific list to act on

visuals.name: accessibility issue heatmap
visuals.shows: which WCAG rule fails on which template
visuals.why_this_chart: shows whether a problem is a one-off or a pattern worth fixing at the theme level

visuals.name: structured data coverage bar
visuals.shows: share of eligible pages with valid, invalid or missing structured data, per page type
visuals.why_this_chart: shows exactly where search and AI engines can and cannot read the store

visuals.name: RTO funnel by pincode tier
visuals.shows: COD orders placed, confirmed, delivered and returned to origin, split by pincode tier
visuals.why_this_chart: shows where in the COD journey money is actually being lost, not just a single RTO percent

visuals.name: staging drift indicator
visuals.type: single stat with a trend line
visuals.shows: days since staging last matched production, over time
visuals.why_this_chart: a stale staging environment is invisible until something breaks in production; this makes the risk visible before that happens

not_elsewhere.claim: checks a real transaction path end to end (add to cart through payment) from several regions, not just whether the homepage returns a 200
not_elsewhere.vs: UptimeRobot and StatusCake ping a URL and report status; they do not run a synthetic checkout

not_elsewhere.claim: ties every accessibility violation to the template it repeats on and routes it straight to a developer brief
not_elsewhere.vs: also in axe DevTools and WAVE for the automated scan itself, which report a flat issue list without grouping by template or assigning it anywhere

not_elsewhere.claim: tracks structured data coverage as one rolling percentage across every eligible page type, not one URL at a time
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Google's Rich Results Test and Search Console for validating a single page; neither gives a store-wide coverage number

not_elsewhere.claim: reads the RTO outcome back against the brand's own delivered-order history to say which COD control actually reduced returns
not_elsewhere.vs: also in COD Guard, Level and RTO Shield for running the checkout-side block or confirmation; they report that the control ran, not whether it worked for this brand

not_elsewhere.claim: cross-references every installed app against the brand's own revenue attribution before calling it dead weight
not_elsewhere.vs: also in Thunder's and similar Shopify app-and-speed audits for counting and weighing apps; they do not check revenue

not_elsewhere.claim: verifies each pre-launch checklist item with the action a real customer would take, not a box someone ticks from memory
not_elsewhere.vs: a manual launch checklist (a spreadsheet or a platform's own launch guide) records that a step was done, not that it was proven

founder_view_note: Before anything is connected, the room shows unavailable across the board and one line: 'no monitoring set up yet; ask the agent to run pre-launch QA or set up uptime checks first'. The first things to populate are the launch checklist (if the store has not launched) or the uptime and checkout status (if it has), since a down store or a broken checkout outranks every other finding here. COD and RTO metrics only appear once order-level logistics status is fed in; until then that panel says what data is missing to turn it on.
